lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6Co4O12 (reduced formula Li3Co2O6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 143), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, and Li in both octahedral and tetrahedral O-coordinated environments. Corner-sharing occurs between Co octahedra and Li tetrahedra, and between Li tetrahedra and octahedra, while Co octahedra and Li octahedra share edges. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
